title: Molecular Agitation
author: Dark Sun Engine
description: A new psychokinetic devotion for psionicists: Molecular Agitation heats a creature's body and gear from within. 1d6 fire damage at once and 1d6 more each round the psionicist keeps it up (2 PSPs a round), a point more a die against anyone with a metal weapon or metal armour; it ends when the psionicist loses sight of the target. 6 PSPs, an Intelligence check at -3. It uses Project Force's icon and Focus Heat's look. Off: the game has only the original's powers.
